title: IMAGEDEF DWG encoder allocation rollback and retry
scope: Generated local IMAGEDEF direct-codec transaction control across versioned body, string and handle streams

implementation.behavior: Stage all effective destinations and preserve version-dependent string/handle placement, including aliased detached streams and streams that remain inline for older revisions. Publish the distinct streams only after all writes succeed.

control.profile: Locally generated IMAGEDEF with nonempty UTF-8 path, finite image/pixel dimensions, loaded flag, resolution, common owner, two reactors and extension dictionary.

cases.mode: inline body with separate arguments ignored

control.failure_assertions: Every reached one-shot allocation fault returns false with all original caller streams, bit cursors and handle-occurrence ledgers unchanged; retrying the same definition and buffers matches clean output.

validation.result: 4/4 focused CTests passed; this encoder passed 127 allocation offsets. The combined allocation control covers 274 reached offsets across 17 stream/version cases; git diff --check passed.

limits: This does not resolve the cross-version IMAGEDEF parent-role conflict or authorize IMAGEDEF/IMAGEDEF_REACTOR output; existing strict-output gates remain unchanged.
Generated codec-level transaction evidence only; no producer prevalence, native image behavior or support claim is established.
Other DWG encoders, OBJECTS builders and whole-drawing failure paths remain open.
